details.eligibility: 10th pass (Matriculation) from a recognised board. Age limit as per CEN notification - verify on rrbapply.gov.in.
details.pattern: Single-stage CBT: 100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes. Negative marking 1/3. Then Physical Efficiency Test (PET), Document Verification and Medical Examination.
details.syllabus: Mathematics (25 Q), General Intelligence & Reasoning (30 Q), General Science (25 Q), General Awareness & Current Affairs (20 Q).
details.important_dates: CEN 08/2024 exam held Nov 2025-Feb 2026. CEN 09/2025 (22,197 vacancies) exam held 3-25 Aug 2026.

notes: ROUND 3 — 2026-11-21. Years by HELD date. CEN 08/2024 CBT ran 27 Nov 2025-10 Feb 2026 (recorded under 2025 by cycle start; its Jan-Feb 2026 shifts are inside that table). CEN 09/2025 (22,197 vacancies) CBT held 3-25 Aug 2026. The 2018 and 2022 cycles are covered by round-1 hubs (Testbook/Adda247/JagranJosh). PET is a physical test — no question papers exist for it. No official paper PDFs exist: RRB publishes only answer keys/response sheets per CEN on rrbapply.gov.in and regional portals.
